name: Glycon
bio: Glycon is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors says the poet's date is unknown.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book X: 124.

poems.title: Book X, 124
poems.author: Glycon
poems.text: All is laughter, all is dust, all is ae for all that is cometh from unreason.

poems.title: Nihilism (Mackail)
poems.author: Glycon
poems.collection: Select Epigrams from the Greek Anthology (1890)
poems.text: All is laughter, and all is dust, and all is nothing; for out of unreason is all that is.
